summary: The school district emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate in providing reliable broadband infrastructure for modern public education, highlighting the costs and benefits of preserving and strengthening the program rather than eliminating it.

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would increase operational costs for school districts
claims.evidence_quote: Mayflower Public School Dist has received $139,700 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $27,940 a year toward the connections our students depend on
